strings: When speaking to r_c0, m_c struggles to explain the feeling of lightheaded dizziness that's been overtaking {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c has been more on edge recently, swaying on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws and struggling to walk straight.

While physically fine, something in m_c's head seems backwards and it's hard to keep {PRONOUN/m_c/self} centered and balanced. Instead, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} feeling dizzy and lightheaded constantly.
